title: 孕妇·步行·同身份完整纸件

source.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One complete reusable paper-theatre pose. Reference is exact identity and style master. Keep same Chinese pregnant woman, dark hair in bun, mustard cardigan, off-white maternity shirt over clearly coherent pregnant belly, teal trousers, cream flat shoes, same pregnancy stage and natural balance; preserve face, age, hairstyle, body proportions, garments and shoes. Change only pose to walking gently toward screen right with comfortable short stride, arms counter-swing, both hands visible, one shoe grounded on baseline; natural balance appropriate to age and pregnancy where applicable. Natural connected complete anatomy, same tactile paper-cut illustration, opaque interior and clean edges. Entire hair/head, visible hands, legs and shoes in frame with generous margin. Single isolated figure, GENUINE transparent background. No chair, environment, floor mark, cast shadow, glow/aura, gradient/vignette, checkerboard, text/logo or props. Do not infantilize older adults or shrink adult anatomy into a child.

usage_notes: 单幅行走关键姿态，使用脚底共同基准配准；不是完整步态循环；手按画面左右，锚点用于试装，不代表可以持握任意物件。按同一人物的头身比例配准，不按PNG外框统一高度。
